decisions.decision: Version current12 in v0.2; retain v0.1 bytes and core9 unchanged. Reject alternative web proposal URIs; no new public auth surface.
DB-derived serverTime/expiresAt/retryAfter on sms; rate deadline+relative Retry-After; own verified registration wait rejoinAfter. No raw code or other-principal retention/restriction metadata.
Current web emits Cache-Control header; exact preflight addition, expose Date/Retry-After/X-Server-Time; origin hook precedes429. No env mutation/wildcards/cookies.

Automatic signup nickname retained. Preserve optional user input as pending explicit post-signup PATCH profile and GET /me exact readback; blank means no update. No signup nickname field and no silent dropping.

No new collection purpose/DDL/storage and no silent omission. Current confirmed-only request rejects extra fields. Parent+uiux decide inactive/revised input surface or explicitly approved future storage contract before enabling that UI path.
Old bearer401 proves session invalid only, cannot prove withdrawal/time. UNKNOWN outcome and no blind retry; no new public status endpoint.

Current grant appends duplicates, no expectedVersion/idempotency. Requery exact kind/version+notification state then explicit confirmation; material-change classification and allowed-operation matrix remain unapproved.

Server-only HTTPS devweb redirect allowlist exists, but native binding/web callback/handoff not implemented. Google provider PKCE only; Kakao/Naver provider PKCE not claimed. No client secret in apps, no unreviewed URL token handoff.

Root Dockerfile modern native TS runtime; railway.json selects backend Dockerfile; strict minimal context. Existing API rootDirectory/image/env and exclusive diagnostic sessions untouched. No git index/commit/push/CLI deploy/DB calls.

Server re-evaluates principal/session/permission/status, current policy eligibility, SMS, timestamps, restrictions and CAS; client validation only assists input/display. canConsent/verified/status/customerNumber/clocks sent by client are not authority. Price/transaction domain absent from this source and not added.
